question: Does the proposed reviewer sub-pattern #4l (an assertion whose subject is a response the same test stubbed) earn a scanner rule, and at what severity?

hypotheses.H1_prevalence: The stub-echo shape occurs in real public Playwright and Cypress suites often enough to justify a scanner rule.
hypotheses.H2_severity: A stub-echo assertion stays green under a product fault that a user-visible assertion on the same behavior catches.
hypotheses.H3_separability: A mechanical detector can separate stub-echo assertions from assertions on rendered output and from assertions on the request the application sent.

corpus.pinning: the sha recorded per repository in that file
corpus.contamination_rule: inherited from field-scan-v1: no repository this project has opened a pull request against
corpus.mutation_policy: no repository is added, dropped, or swapped after collection starts

collector.publishes: every candidate with repository, file, line, and matched snippet
collector.scope: files under the reviewer scanner's spec globs that contain both a response observer and a stub marker

adjudication.timing: every candidate judged before any threshold is computed

G1_prevalence.pass: at least 5 instances in at least 2 distinct repositories

G2_separability.metric: Wilson 95% lower bound of STUB_ECHO / adjudicated candidates
G2_separability.pass: at least 0.50 for the collector and at least 0.80 for the drafted scanner rule re-run over the same corpus

G3_severity.pass: the stub-echo spec stays green under the injected product fault, the rendered-output spec turns red under the same fault, and both are green without it

G4_guard.pass: zero hits on route.continue() pass-through, page.request/cy.request, request.postDataJSON(), and rendered-output assertions

decisions.all_gates_pass: implement #4l as a P0 sub-pattern of #4 across the seven taxonomy surfaces with true-positive and false-positive-guard evals
decisions.G3_fails: do not add a P0 rule; the shape is not an always-pass
decisions.G1_fails_only: document the shape in the #4 Phase 2 procedure; add no scanner rule
decisions.G2_or_G4_fails: keep Phase 2 documentation and record why a mechanical rule was refused

publication: a result that misses a gate is published unchanged; no threshold moves after collection

gate_outcomes.G1_prevalence: FAIL (0 STUB_ECHO instances; 5 required in 2 repositories)

result.decision: document the shape in the #4 Phase 2 procedure; add no scanner rule
